symptom: When no review or QA result existed, the self-maintenance active-gates snapshot reported the structured gate as allowed with ok=true, so no_code_branch and auto_merge_disabled decisions falsely claimed an unevaluated governance gate had passed.
root_cause: The structured report gate and active-gate snapshot used binary pass/fail semantics and defaulted missing structured evidence to success instead of preserving a non-blocking, not-evaluated state.
